caller_authority: Tern next-task directive for MP-IMG4 (baseline 669fafca318944066596368e2ca73b37859d1781) under the Caller's resumption instruction and ADR-0014. Round-1 and round-2 review repairs are included.

profile.debug_note: The debug profile aborts with a main-thread stack overflow on this host regardless of this change (§19.214); native sets use release.

round_2_review_repairs: B-01: no release is inferred from an integer generation change any more. release_terminated_generation and its media counterpart were removed; an in-flight payload stays quarantined and charged, and no code path frees it without a measured termination, so the honest outcome is retention until process exit or a future device-teardown proof

B-02: a process-wide quarantine ledger (PROCESS_QUARANTINE_CAP_BYTES, 64 MiB) spans every device generation; a new admission is refused with QuarantineBudgetExhausted once it is full, and an eviction that would exceed it is refused before any atlas entry is dropped

B-03: attach binds the owning window before the first paint, so a frame prepared and attached but never painted is collected by the close sweep; a frame whose paint state is locked during the sweep is reported as unattributed instead of being charged to this window
A-01: the manifest counts every setup, decode, prepare and attach failure, requires the exact ConsumersRemain reason at both consumer gates, and exits non-zero on any mismatch
A-02: unattributed lock contention is a separate counter in EvictionSummary and the close log

implementation.ownership: ConsumerId + attach/detach; attach also records the owning window, so ownership exists before the first paint. Every release path (evict, discard_unpainted, close sweep) enforces an empty consumer set.
implementation.eviction: evict refuses NotRetained, PaintInProgress, ConsumersRemain, NotOwnedByWindow and QuarantineBudgetExhausted, then removes every tile from the owning window's atlas, releases a never-uploaded admission, or quarantines an in-flight one against the process ledger.
implementation.quarantine: quarantined payloads stay charged to their generation's pool and to the process ledger; no generation-number assertion releases them. When the ledger or the pool's staging/in-flight allowance is exhausted, new work is refused explicitly.
implementation.window_close: evict_owned_by sweeps frames the window owns (including pre-paint frames bound by attach), reports evicted/skipped/unattributed/images/released/quarantined, and never silently drops a frame.
implementation.lazy_recreation: a new device generation creates a pool on first use and resources are re-prepared on demand; an evicted identity paints PaintStatus::Evicted, and a quarantined identity is refused as DuplicateRepresentation until a safe release exists.

manifest.next_prepare_refusal: Admission(BudgetExceeded) because the retained unproven payload occupies the pool's staging/in-flight allowance
manifest.ledger_note: the pool reports quarantine per resource category, so one 16 MiB payload reads as 50,331,648 B summed across staging, in-flight and resident; each category has its own 64 MiB limit

sampled_working_set.method: external PowerShell sampler polling Get-Process WorkingSet64 every 150 ms
sampled_working_set.note: short run; the peak includes the retained payload and the PNG generation buffer, so it is a sampled working set for one execution, not a budget sum

interactive.claim: Evict current reports atlas images=16, released_staged=0 B, quarantined=16777216 B with retained_frames=0. Reloading the same identity afterwards is refused with Admission(DuplicateRepresentation), because its payload is still retained and no completion was measured. Evict owned and close exits 0.

resources_and_owners.owner: media AdmittedUpload inside the frame, or the pool's quarantine after an eviction
resources_and_owners.capacity: 16 MiB per frame; process quarantine ledger 64 MiB
resources_and_owners.release: staged: release() at eviction; in-flight: never released without a measured termination (retained until process exit or MP-REC1 teardown proof)
resources_and_owners.generation: identity generation; the ledger is process-wide

resources_and_owners.owner: owning window, bound at attach or first paint
resources_and_owners.capacity: not observable in the public API

resources_and_owners.owner: media pool per generation, bounded by the process ledger
resources_and_owners.capacity: 64 MiB per pool category, 64 MiB process ledger
resources_and_owners.release: no measured release path; new work refused at the cap
